params.body:
Buying a car over from a colleague died on any car carrying at least one damage photo.

`vehicle_damage_media` has no `thumbnail_path` column, so `$media->thumbnail_path` is always null there, and `copyVehiclesFileOrIgnore(string $from, string $to)` raised a `TypeError` at the **call site** — before the `try` inside it, and so uncatchable by the very method whose name promises to ignore.

It died after the copy was created and before the `vehicle_history` row and the two confirmation mails. Because the controller finds the copy, the screen still answered "done": the buyer saw the car while both garages lost their order sheet and their mail. Nobody had a reason to suspect it, which is why it surfaced as a phone call about a car from three days earlier.

## What was measured

On production, 28 September 2026:

- Of the three buy-overs since the cutover, **23073** (24/09) carried no damage photo and completed with its row; **23145** (28/09 18:00, Auto Jeroen from StockCars) carried one and broke.
- The `TypeError` for 23145 is in the log at 18:01:12, pointing at `Vehicle.php` line 110.
- **54 cars then for sale carried at least one damage photo**, so this was set to keep happening rather than being a one-off.
- The try/catch placed around `logHistory` earlier the same day does not help here: the throw lands before it.

## The change

An empty path here is not an error but a file that does not exist, which is exactly what this method is meant to ignore. So it takes `?string` and returns early on blank.

`BuyOverTest::a_damage_photo_does_not_take_the_transaction_with_it` pins it. It fails on the old signature with `The table is empty`, and it asserts the `vehicle_history` row rather than the HTTP response — because the response was never the thing that broke. That is the part worth keeping: the screen said "done" throughout.

## Still open

The case this finding started from, 26 September at Garage Vanhees, had **no damage photos at all**, so it did not break here. For that request there is no error anywhere, and every testable explanation is excluded: the controller has reported every throw since 15 September (proven by the 18:00 one landing in the log), `logHistory` has no silent exit, no observer on `VehicleHistory` can veto `save()`, nothing in the code deletes from `vehicle_history`, the table has no `deleted_at`, and the copy persisted so nothing rolled back. Its row was repaired by hand on 28/09 at 14:34 with `create:vehicle-history`; the two mails were never sent and that repair does not send them.

The finding therefore stays open: one path is found and closed, and at least one is not.

## Also here

The Dutch identifiers in the test file this touches are renamed to English (`koop`, `wagen`, `userVoor`, the seven Dutch test names and the fixture strings), per the convention that code is English.
params.title: A damage photo no longer takes the transaction with it
